subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS standardize agent, session, and model selection on Home and accept the capability-gated mixed Phone/Watch upgrade contract that replaces the separate Agent and Session pages?
rationale: The implementation is well-tested and proof-positive, but the remaining question is product ownership of a user-visible navigation consolidation and its paired-device compatibility contract, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the Home workflow
options.body: Approve the capability-gated Home controls as the canonical Wear context-management path and merge after normal exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep dedicated pages
options.body: Retain the existing Agent and Session pages and request a narrower Home enhancement if the compact-control workflow is not the desired Wear UX.

options.title: Pause for broader Wear UX review
options.body: Hold the PR if navigation consolidation needs a wider product decision beyond this paired-device implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the capability-gated Home controls as the canonical Wear context-management path and merge after normal exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the recent hardening work that defines the compatibility behavior under review.
